statement: First report of acute pancreatitis as a complication of babesiosis: 4 histological and 16 probable cases
Lesions: peripancreatic fat necrosis; interstitial oedema; neutrophils; vascular thrombosis; patchy
Histologically confirmed incidence at least 0.32% of admitted babesiosis cases
Median time to diagnosis 2.5 days after admission; range day 0 to day 15
Mostly young intact dogs; median age 3 years
Proposed mechanism ischaemia (anaemia; hypotension; haemoconcentration) with reperfusion; cytokines may sustain injury; unrelated to anaemia at admission
'Gut form' may represent pancreatitis
Probable AP threshold: amylase >3600 U/L and/or lipase >650 U/L (abstract says amylase >3500)
